evidence.quote: verified the calibration against the June reference plates

observations.why: Verification against a fixed external standard enacts authority-ranking: the reference plates hold rank over the instrument's output, ratifying its calibration.
Labeling the instrument under a structured field header subordinates it to a classification system that holds authority over what counts as a valid entry.
Restating verification against a fixed reference standard enacts the same authority-ranking subordination of instrument output to an external arbiter.
